text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You were back to your old self out
there!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That was the strength I've yearned to
best for so
long.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to have you as a rival.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Please keep on running. With me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki and Oguri Cap's smiling
faces
usher the Arima Kinen to a cheery
close.
